title: Nine Years of Mending
subtitle: 衣物与穿着 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 衣物与穿着（生活与学习·服饰与仪表）
meta: 主题语境：衣物与穿着（生活与学习·服饰与仪表）　|　核心词汇：clothes　|　正文 337 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 clothes 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1947 my mother was sent to mend ① clothes she could not replace, and she said the mending was the whole of the lesson. The ② clothes, meaning the garments and not the cloth, were nine years old and were mended by whoever came last; clothes, she said, are the only thing in a house that is judged by how much has been taken out of them.

Every ③ clothes in that house had the same patch, and the ④ clothes at the end, meaning the ones the mother kept and not either of those, were the only ones anybody ever mended properly. Clothes, my grandmother said, are nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the patience is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ clothes were the whole of the photograph, meaning the Sunday they carried and not the garments. The ⑥ clothes, meaning the Sunday and not any of that, are the only thing in a photograph that everybody notices and nobody questions; clothes, he said, are either something you mend or the only word that means both garments and a Sunday. She said the Sunday is the part they remember.

By 1962 the ⑦ clothes had become a number in a report, and the report had become an argument about the patch. The ⑧ clothes of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, were nine years and eleven years of mending; clothes, she said, are either the ones at the end or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ clothes I remember are the ones at the end, which were mended in 1967 and are still described as the warmest in the county. A ⑩ suit of clothes, my grandmother said in 1972, is the only thing that improves by being mended; every suit of clothes, she said, is a Sunday that has agreed to look like garments. She said the Sunday was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 衣服（指那些衣裳本身，与那块布相对）
C. 固定搭配：mend clothes 缝补衣物
D. n. 衣服（指那栋房子里每一身）
E. n. 衣服（指末尾那一身）
F. n. 节日盛装（抽象：它承载的那个礼拜天）
G. n. 那个礼拜天（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: The clothes, meaning the garments and not the cloth
clothes were the whole of the photograph
the clothes had become a number in a report
The clothes of the whole thing
A suit of clothes, my grandmother said in 1972

answers.why: mend clothes 意为“缝补衣物”，1947 年母亲被派去补她换不起的那身衣服。
clothes 意为“衣服、衣物”，指那些衣裳本身而不是那块布，穿了九年，由最后来的人补。
clothes 指那栋房子里每一身衣服，每一身都是同样的补丁。
clothes 指末尾那一身（母亲留下的那一身），是唯一有人认真补过的。
clothes 意为“节日盛装”，抽象指它承载的那个礼拜天，父亲说 clothes 就是那张照片的全部。
clothes 为抽象用法，指那个礼拜天本身，是一张照片里人人都注意到、却没人质疑的东西。
clothes 意为“衣服、衣物”，到 1962 年这身 clothes 成了报告里的一个数字。
clothes 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九年与十一年的缝补。
clothes 意为“衣服”，我记得的是末尾那一身，1967 年补过，至今仍被说成全县最暖的。
clothes 为抽象总称，祖母说一身衣服是唯一会因为被认真缝补而变好的东西。
